name: workplace-conversation-prep
description:
Prepares the user for a difficult workplace conversation by scripting the opening
statement, anticipated responses with branching dialogue, and de-escalation moves.
Covers feedback delivery, conflict resolution, boundary setting, and saying no to
scope creep. Produces a conversation script with branches.
Use when the user needs to have a difficult conversation at work, deliver tough
feedback, resolve a conflict with a colleague, set boundaries, or push back on
unreasonable requests.
Do NOT use for salary negotiation (use salary-negotiation-script), performance review
preparation (use performance-review-prep), or mentorship outreach (use mentorship-outreach).
